business.description: The Company is in Trading and real estate Industry and will focus on Real Estate and allied businesses.

products.name: Sale of Goods
products.note: Sales include excise duty, where applicable and represent invoice value of goods sold as reduced by rebates and discounts.

products.name: Sale of Flats
products.note: Sale of flat purchased from other developers is recognized on execution of transfer deed in favour of the buyer.

products.name: Real Estate Development Project
products.note: The Company follows completed project method of accounting. Allocable expenses incurred during the year are debited to work-in-progress account. The income is accounted for as and when the projects get completed or substantially completed.

products.name: Construction Contracts
products.note: Revenue from each Real Estate Development Project is recognized on the basis of Percentage Completion Method when stage of completion reaches at least 25% of total estimated cost and at least 25% of sale consideration is collected.

products.name: Royalty
products.note: Revenue is recognized on an accrual basis in accordance with the terms of the relevant agreement.

products.name: Interest
products.note: Interest on fixed deposits is recognized on accrual basis on a time proportion basis.

products.name: Dividend
products.note: Revenue is recognized when the right to receive the income is established.

products.name: Rent
products.note: Revenue is recognized on an accrual basis in accordance with the terms of the relevant agreement.
